patch.value:
pm-cli now needs its main CHANGELOG.md to be fully generated by pm-changelog across the actual released version history, not only the latest release window and not only tracker release metadata.

Current behavior in pm-changelog@2026.5.24-11:
- latest release range mode works for one section with --release-version-from-package --since-previous-tag --until-release-tag
- full output can cover the large tracker (807 items in pm-cli) when no range is passed
- --group-by release groups by pm item release metadata, producing headings such as Unreleased/vnext/archive-2026q2 rather than actual git/npm release tags

Needed package-owned behavior:
- generate a full Keep a Changelog-style CHANGELOG.md from all relevant git tags, newest first
- include an Unreleased section for closed items after the latest tag
- derive each released section's date from the tag/commit timestamp
- assign pm items to the tag window by item close/update/create timestamp
- keep item IDs/link generation and --check support working for large trackers

This should be fixed in pm-changelog, not papered over in pm-cli with a custom script.
